subject: Strategic capacity cover and accelerator match request
messages:
From: Jenna Park <jenna@clearviewhealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearviewhealth.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: initial sizing — requested accelerator family

Connor — thanks for the run-through earlier. We're excited about Redwood but have one sticking point from procurement: ClearView's workload testing shows a 6–8 week stretch where H100-class instances materially improve throughput for our model fan-out.

Procurement has signaled they will not approve a long-term H100 commitment without a price concession or a trial window. Can Redwood offer a temporary H100 eligibility on Dedicated with an overage cap and reservation hold while we finalize a 12-month commitment? Also need SOC2 artifacts and an updated SOW to move legal.

Attached our suggested capacity ramp (capacity_plan.xlsx) and procurement instructions.

— Jenna
Senior ML Platform, ClearView Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jenna Park <jenna@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: initial sizing — requested accelerator family

Jenna — appreciate the clarity and the plan. I'm looping in Lauren (deal desk) and Karthik (pricing) to propose an executable path. Quick summary of asks from your side:
- Temporary H100 eligibility for Dedicated for a 90-day trial window
- Reservation hold while ClearView completes internal approvals (60 days)
- Overage cap by token/hour during the trial to limit billing risk
- SOC2 evidence and updated SOW

I'm proposing we offer a limited pilot concession: a one-time onboarding credit and an overage cap for the trial with a commitment trigger that converts the pilot to a reserved term. Need internal approval for: 1) crossing the H100 SKU boundary for a new Dedicated customer, 2) applying a discounted overage cap, and 3) putting a 60-day hold on reservation activation without immediate billing.

Lauren / Karthik — can you review and advise on what level of discount and whether legal needs a special clause for the temporary accelerator match? I can pull in Vanessa if we need exec signoff.

Thanks — Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 10:48:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: initial sizing — requested accelerator family

Connor / Karthik — reviewed the ask and ClearView looks strategically important (healthcare, potential to expand across three lines of business). I think a narrowly-scoped concession makes sense to keep momentum. Recommended package to propose to ClearView: 

- Temporary "accelerator match": allow H100-class Dedicated access for 90 days under a trial pricing tier (no SKU swap for billing)
- Overage cap: cap overage at 150% of the base committed rate for the trial period
- Reservation hold: allow a 60-day activation hold with a structural clause that billing starts on activation or at the end of hold (whichever comes first) — request legal to add fallback if hold exceeds 60 days
- One-time onboarding credit: USD 25k applied pro-rata on first invoice if ClearView signs a 12-month reservation within 120 days of pilot

I'll need an executive approval on any deviation to our default overage bands and on allowing H100 access prior to a full reserved SKU allocation. Vanessa — can you weigh in? Also see attachment: ClearView_SOW_v1.pdf (Connor shared earlier).

— Lauren
Director, Deal Desk

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: initial sizing — requested accelerator family

Adding pricing detail and risk notes. Connor / Lauren — my initial calc for the proposed concession: 

- If ClearView uses H100 during the 90-day trial and signs the 12-month reservation at the end, the blended yield with the onboarding credit nets a ~11% reduction on our expected ARR for year one but materially increases likelihood of expansion.
- Overage cap at 150% is acceptable for the trial, but we should require a soft cap audit: engineering will provide a weekly usage report and we reserve the right to pause bursts if usage pattern suggests abuse.
- Reservation hold: allow 60 days; billing will start on activation date or automatically at day 61 if no activation. Legal should include a cancellation fee if hold exceeds 60 days and we have committed pool planning exposure.

Given the business case and health vertical, I'm +1 on the concession with the following exec-level asks:
1) Exec signoff to permit temporary H100 eligibility before customer has a reserved H100 SKU
2) Approval for USD 25k onboarding credit as a one-time, non-recurring item
3) Authorization to accept the 150% overage cap for the 90-day pilot

Vanessa — please confirm if you can approve (1)-(3). I will prepare the pricing appendix and a short addendum for legal to lock into the SOW.

— Karthik
Head of Pricing, Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, connor_obrien@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: initial sizing — requested accelerator family

Team — after reviewing the account, pipeline, and risk calc, I approve the concession with the following guarded conditions: 

1) Approve temporary H100 eligibility for a maximum 90-day pilot window contingent on a signed pilot addendum (non-binding on long-term commit)
2) Approve one-time onboarding credit: USD 25,000 (non-recurring) applied pro-rata on first invoice if a 12-month reservation is executed within 120 days of pilot start
3) Approve overage cap at 150% for pilot; installs will include engineered usage reporting and a weekly review with the ClearView technical lead. If we detect anomalous sustained burst > 3x baseline for more than two consecutive weeks, Redwood can pause burst access with 24h notice
4) Approve a 60-day reservation hold. Billing will start on activation or at day 61 automatically; if ClearView requests an extension beyond 60 days, deal desk must escalate and provide exposure justification

Operational notes for Sales/CS/Legal: please include a short clause in the SOW that describes the trial, the automatic billing trigger, and the onboarding credit redemption mechanics. Legal to add a cancellation fee of one month of committed spend if hold exceeds 60 days and we have capacity pre-allocated. Procurement, please confirm SOC2 receipt (SOC2_L2.pdf was attached earlier).

Connor — you have exec signoff to proceed and present this as a limited pilot; copy these exact terms into the addendum and DocuSign flow. Keep me posted if any new risk signals emerge.

— Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Commercial Operations, Redwood Inference
